title: Follow (envelope)
description: Listens to a sound and makes a control that follows how loud it is: a car passing, a kick, a voice. Choose the band (so the cars count, not the rain), subtract the steady background, and say how fast it rises and falls. The control steers any parameter that can be automated, and the gate is on while the sound is above a level.

outputs.name: level
outputs.title: Level
outputs.description: How loud the sound is, as a control.

outputs.name: gate
outputs.title: Gate
outputs.description: 1 while the sound is above the threshold (and for the hold time after), else 0.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off makes a control that stays at the low end of the range.

parameters.name: band
parameters.placeholder: full, low, mid, high or 80 Hz .. 400 Hz
parameters.doc: Which part of the sound is followed: full, low (below 200 Hz), mid (200 to 2000 Hz), high (above 2000 Hz), or your own range such as 80 Hz .. 400 Hz. auto chooses the band where the loud moments stand out most from the background of the recording.

parameters.name: baseline
parameters.doc: On subtracts the slow average of the level, so a steady background (rain) does not count and only what stands out of it (a passing car) does.

parameters.name: baseline_window
parameters.doc: How slowly the background is followed: longer ignores longer stretches of rain. auto sets it from how long a loud moment lasts.

parameters.name: attack
parameters.doc: How fast the control rises when the sound gets louder. auto sets it from the recording.

parameters.name: release
parameters.doc: How fast the control falls when the sound gets softer. auto sets it from the recording.

parameters.name: normalize
parameters.doc: On: the loudest moment of the sound is 1. Off: the control is the level against full scale.

parameters.name: curve
parameters.doc: soft lifts the quiet parts (a square root), so a distant car still moves the control.

parameters.name: range
parameters.doc: What 0 and 1 of the level become: two numbers with .. between them, in the unit of the control (600 Hz .. 3600 Hz with unit Hz).

parameters.name: unit
parameters.doc: The unit of the control this block makes. none: a general control (a level from 0 to 1) that is scaled to the range of the parameter it steers. Hz, dB, ...: a typed control that only steers a parameter in that unit; the range is then written in that unit.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.doc: Where the gate switches on (a part of the loudest moment).

parameters.name: hold
parameters.doc: How long the gate stays on after the sound has dropped below the threshold.
